_comment: ai_grid.v1.Tenant in protojson, as the backend maps Keycloak 26.8 Organizations in the ai-grid realm (mock/research/keycloak.md section 4): id = organization UUID, name and alias unique in the realm (alias defaults to name and never changes), domains = the names of domainDetails in the same order, lower-case, unique across organizations; verified is free-form metadata, identityProviderAlias/autoRedirect route a domain's logins to an organization IdP. The fake realm has no identity providers, so no domain may set identityProviderAlias (Keycloak rejects an unknown alias with "Identity provider with alias '<alias>' does not exist in realm ai-grid"); autoRedirect is stored without a check, as Keycloak stores it. attributes carry the first value of each Keycloak attribute. createTime is when the backend created the organization (proposal P3; the backend keeps it in the attribute ai-grid/create-time, which never appears in attributes); only acme-robotics has one, so the others show no creation time. identityProvider (proposal P1) is the organization's OIDC identity provider as the console configures it, on a fictional example.com issuer; the three organizations the PoC port shares have one, the others have none. All values are fictional. The fake validates the file like Keycloak would (duplicate name/alias/domain, bad domain, identity provider alias, non-UUID id fail at start). Other modes, one at a time: {"unavailable": "request Keycloak token: dial tcp ...: connection refused"} makes every Tenants RPC Unavailable (Keycloak unreachable); {"realmMissing": true} makes them FailedPrecondition with Realm not found. (the dev hub today, whose Keycloak has no ai-grid realm); {"organizationsDisabled": true} makes them FailedPrecondition with Organizations not enabled for this realm.
